title: The fs.Stats constructor is deprecated
summary: Node.js deprecates the fs.Stats constructor (DEP0180: documentation-only since v20.13.0, runtime deprecation since v22.0.0).

constraints: Keep the behavior of the code unchanged; check the replacement's argument and return-value differences.

steps.title: Replace the usage
steps.instructions: Replace each reported use of the fs.Stats constructor with code that no longer depends on it.
